environment: Node / simulated DOM, IndexedDB and Chrome APIs

tests.name: Clipped targets keep the intersection with the visible viewport
Custom roles survive capture, edit and a backup round trip
Legacy 1.0.1 backup retains every note, image, code and deleted record
Same IndexedDB stores reopen without a migration or changed IDs
Verification needs a result, preserves the issue ID and records time
Changing agreed requirements reopens verified work and clears the approval time
Discussion, hold, verification and done are excluded from request-only packets
Meeting packets link PNG originals and after images correctly, without embedding scripts
Image-free export removes every image from every output format
Invalid prototype enum names and infinite viewport sizes are rejected
A blocked database fails explicitly and retries with a fresh connection
Database open timeout is recoverable and no automatic write retry occurs
Desk failed startup shows retry and disables writes until recovery
Rapid edits of verified notes do not accidentally restore old approval
Concurrent edit conflict keeps typed draft and offers a recovery download
